repos_data.description: Open-source screenshot and screen recording for macOS. The free, native alternative to CleanShot X. Built with Swift 6.0 and SwiftUI.
Feature-packed native macOS screenshot & recording tool: annotate, auto-redact PII, record GIFs, OCR + translate, scroll capture, beautify, and more. No Electron, no subscription.
The macOS screen recorder for the rest of us - always free and open source with a native look and feel  📺
Screen recording on macOS, from capture to delivery, no detours.
Minimalist macOS OCR tool. Open-source, privacy-first, and built with SwiftUI.

⌘⌘ - A lightweight, native macOS screenshot tool that lives in your menu bar. Double-tap ⌘ Command to capture any region of your screen — instantly copied to clipboard, or annotate first with pen and mosaic tools.
(Development of Screenize is currently paused) Open-source macOS screen recording app with auto-zoom, cursor effects, and timeline editing — Screen Studio alternative.

MS Paint for the Mac. Native, free and open source: blank canvas at any size, drop one image onto another, crop, and mark up screenshots. Ships PaintKit, a UI-free drawing engine with no AppKit and no third-party dependencies: macOS 12+, and swift test runs it in a fresh clone with no Xcode.
A native, local macOS toolbox for screenshots, OCR, measuring, keep-awake, pointer tools, shortcuts, windows, workspaces, voice and MCP.
Screen translation app for macOS — select any area, get instant translation. On-device by default with Apple Vision OCR + Apple Translation.
A macOS voice, screenshot, clipboard, and coding-agent workbench.
Simple screen and microphone audio recorder for Mac
